name: OpenClaw 每日健康监控 Loop
goal: 每天检查 Gateway、cron、备份和 doctor，只报告可操作异常

context.current_state: Gateway 自启动已修复，备份由 OpenClaw 自己执行

cycle.instruction: Read real context, existing artifacts, and previous state. Confirm this turn has one verifiable target.
cycle.expected_output: Turn scope, known evidence, gaps, and explicit non-goals

cycle.instruction: Take the smallest useful action toward the goal: 每天检查 Gateway、cron、备份和 doctor，只报告可操作异常
cycle.expected_output: This turn's artifact or change list

cycle.instruction: Run or perform these verifiers: Gateway 端口; cron ok; backup verify; doctor 无 error
cycle.expected_output: Pass, fail, or missing-evidence status for each verifier

cycle.instruction: Write this turn's evidence, verifier results, state change, and next action to durable memory.
cycle.expected_output: Updated PROGRESS.md, reports.jsonl entry, or equivalent durable state

cycle.instruction: Decide whether to continue, stop, rollback, or ask for human confirmation based on verifier results.

verifiers.proves: This turn satisfies: Gateway 端口
This turn satisfies: doctor 无 error

stop_rules: Stop when every verifier has current evidence and passes.
Stop and narrow the problem after the same verifier fails twice.
Stop and ask for confirmation when the goal, input, or permissions do not match the current context.

rollback.trigger: Any verifier fails, evidence is missing, or an action crosses a constraint
rollback.action: Revert this turn's output or keep the prior state, record the failing evidence, then return to inspect with a narrower scope.

memory.read: At the start of each turn, read prior state, failures, passed verifiers, and human approvals.
memory.write: At the end of each turn, write action_id, evidence, verifier results, stop decision, and next step.

loop_parts.automation: Define the trigger, cadence, or wake-up condition that discovers work without a manual prompt.
loop_parts.isolation: Use worktrees or an equivalent boundary when parallel agents could touch the same files.
loop_parts.skills: Put repeatable project knowledge in reusable instructions instead of retyping a long prompt each turn.
loop_parts.connectors: List external systems the loop may read or update; keep filesystem-only loops explicit when there are none.
loop_parts.evaluator: Keep the maker away from the checker: verifier evidence must be reviewable by a separate pass or human.
loop_parts.memory: Persist progress on disk or in an external tracker; do not rely on the chat context as memory.

cost_controls.verification_debt: Do not accept self-graded completion; require concrete verifier evidence before stop.
cost_controls.comprehension_rot: Keep summaries and changed-state notes current so a human can still explain what changed.
cost_controls.token_blowout: Use one bounded target per turn, max iterations, and explicit stop rules to cap runaway work.
cost_controls.cognitive_surrender: Keep human gates for scope changes, external effects, and judgment calls the loop cannot own.

human_gates: Ask for human confirmation before changing external state, publishing, sending, deleting, or paying.
